rationale: Setup always binds at ss/100C/1.60V max-RC, so wire RC matters; hold (+0.055 ns min), slew/cap (<=19 vs bar 295) and DRC (all 0) are non-issues. The five best runs all used AREA 3; DELAY 3/4 and AREA 2 were 1.4-4.9 ns worse. Only the loose-target runs (0.93/0.98) were port-limited (I/O delay scales with period) while their reg-to-reg was 6.6-7.5 ns, so pin the tightest target, 0.45 (8.59 ns), nearest the reachable clock. The two best runs combined cap213, timing-driven placement and post-GRT timing repair; stock-RC aes_cipher missed by 1.4 ns. Timing repair idles while the target exceeds natural delay, so margins can't be learned now but drive the re-run ratchet: pin 0.3.
